A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Duros thug''' worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Jabba ordered his Duros employee to meet the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[D'Wopp]] on the very day of his [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] with Lady [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the Hutt's greatest rival. The Duros thug's mission was to a offer D'Wopp a bounty he would be eager to accept, in hopes the Whiphid would leave the [[Wedding of Valarian and D'Wopp|wedding celebration]] and ruin it.
